topic.angle: People reject free money to punish unfair offers

body.question: Two players split a sum. The proposer makes an offer; the responder can accept it, or reject it so that neither gets anything. When the offer is under 30%, what do responders often do?
body.reveal: Offers of less than 30% are often rejected, even though rejecting means neither player receives anything. A review of 37 studies found the first player typically offers around 40% of the "pie".

probes.question: True or false: in the ultimatum game, if the responder rejects the offer, neither player receives anything.
A review of 37 studies found the first player typically offers about what share of the pie?
